_comment: MCVS Offline Cosmetic crate (economy collector) tuning: the rule inputs of docs/design/economy-collector.md section 1.
tools/content-gen/content_gen.py validates it against the player's decoded data (design tables, catalogue, loc ids,
assets) and writes server/Content/collector.json (ids only). Weights, items per crate and the other runtime knobs are
settings (economy.collector.*), not content. The crate's live-ops rewards and their start date are the 'collector'

crate._locId: CUSTOMIZATION CRATE: differs in every language from Crate.Cosmetics_Crate, the name of the 65 weekly event crates (Crate.Cosmetic_Crate reads the same in 7 languages)

kayac._comment: Kayac/Kayac2 emblems never come from the crate (O5): asset under one of the folders (prefixes, so Kayac/ includes Kayac/holidays/), or 'nameContains' in the file name (case-insensitive), or an 'extra' id (382 Japan Cup, 383 Kayac logo)

_reservePlacementEmblems: true: the starred season emblems are kept for ranks 1-3 of a division season (D4), not in the crate
_soundCarrier: the random signature row each sound rides on (D8): Background (a 35-entry list per IsAvailable/preview, not the 1,518 avatars) or Avatar
_skins: [merc, skin]: the no-source skins, one MercSkin row each, in this order
_hiddenJerseys: VisibleInShop=false jerseys (11 of the 12 use Kayac-folder art, named by O5): remove an id to drop it
_exhausted: the row that pays when every collectible is owned (D7); economy.collector.exhaustedReward replaces it at run time
_rows: row order: exhausted first, so CrateRewardItem.IsAvailable (any row available, in table order) stops at a VersusCoins row without building a signature list
